sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 在2011年，人们在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园里发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血液也被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来她的凶手费尽心思来掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 接着，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是“罪案档案之声”推出的全新系列，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: 1982 was shaping up to be a good year for André Bomberski.
sentences.zh: 对安德烈·邦贝尔斯基来说，1982年本来应该是美好的一年。

sentences.en: The 44-year-old accountant lived in Peshbusk, a small village just outside Toulouse in the southwest of France.
sentences.zh: 这位44岁的会计师住在佩什比斯克，这是法国西南部图卢兹郊外的一个小村庄。

sentences.en: A bitter divorce seven years prior had resulted in André losing custody of his two children, Kalinka and Nicolas,
sentences.zh: 七年前的一场痛苦离婚导致安德烈失去了两个孩子卡林卡和尼古拉的抚养权，

sentences.en: who had gone to live with their mother and her new husband in the German town of Lindau.
sentences.zh: 他们随母亲及她的新丈夫搬到了德国小镇林道生活。

sentences.en: This put a distance of over 1,000 kilometres between André and his children, which was an ongoing source of pain for the doting father,
sentences.zh: 这使得安德烈和孩子们之间的距离超过了1000公里，这位慈父对此一直感到痛苦万分，

sentences.en: as he continued to simultaneously grapple with the harsh reality that his wife had left him for another man.
sentences.zh: 因为他同时还要艰难面对妻子为了另一个男人抛弃他的残酷现实。

sentences.en: André missed his children terribly, and he was therefore relieved when it was decided that 14-year-old Kalinka
sentences.zh: 安德烈非常思念孩子们，因此，当得知14岁的卡林卡

sentences.en: and 11-year-old Nicolas would return to France to live with him at the end of the summer of 1982.
sentences.zh: 和11岁的尼古拉将在1982年夏天结束时回到法国与他一起生活时，他感到如释重负。

sentences.en: Kalinka had always been a very intelligent girl, but she'd been struggling academically at the boarding school she attended in Germany,
sentences.zh: 卡林卡一直是个非常聪明的女孩，但她在德国就读的寄宿学校里学业上有些吃力，

sentences.en: and she was missing her old life back in France.
sentences.zh: 而且她很怀念过去在法国的生活。

sentences.en: It was agreed that the children would spend the summer vacation with their mother and stepfather in Lindau before moving back to Peshbusk with André that September.
sentences.zh: 双方商定，孩子们将在林道与母亲和继父共度暑假，然后于当年9月搬回佩什比斯克与安德烈同住。

sentences.en: This was welcome news for André, who had recently started a new relationship for the first time since his divorce.
sentences.zh: 这对安德烈来说是个好消息，他最近刚刚开启了自离婚以来的第一段新恋情。

sentences.en: After a difficult few years, everything seemed to be falling into place for a fresh start.
sentences.zh: 经历了几年的艰难时光后，一切似乎都在步入正轨，准备迎接新的开始。

sentences.en: That all changed on the morning of Saturday, July 10, 1982, just two months before Kalinka and Nicolas were set to return to France.
sentences.zh: 然而这一切在1982年7月10日星期六的早晨全变了，当时距离卡林卡和尼古拉预定回法国的时间仅仅两个月。

sentences.en: That day, the phone rang at André's house.
sentences.zh: 那天，安德烈家里的电话响了。

sentences.en: It was his ex-wife, Danielle Kronbach.
sentences.zh: 打电话来的是他的前妻达妮埃尔·克龙巴赫。

sentences.en: She was beside herself.
sentences.zh: 她情绪崩溃。

sentences.en: Kalinka's dead, she sobbed.
sentences.zh: 卡林卡死了，她泣不成声地说。

sentences.en: André Bombersky listened in shock as Danielle explained that Kalinka had spent the previous day of Friday, July 9, windsurfing on Lake Constance,
sentences.zh: 安德烈·邦贝尔斯基震惊地听着达妮埃尔解释说，卡林卡在前一天7月9日星期五一直在博登湖上玩帆板运动，

sentences.en: the crystal clear bay located behind the Kronbach's home in Lindau.
sentences.zh: 博登湖是位于林道克龙巴赫家后面的清澈海湾。

sentences.en: Danielle, Kalinka and Nicolas lived there with Danielle's husband, a respected cardiologist named Dieter Kronbach,
sentences.zh: 达妮埃尔、卡林卡和尼古拉与达妮埃尔的丈夫——一位名叫迪特尔·克龙巴赫的受人尊敬的心脏病专家一起住在那里，

sentences.en: as well as Dr. Kronbach's two older children from a previous marriage.
sentences.zh: 还有克龙巴赫医生与前妻所生的两个大孩子。

sentences.en: Danielle said that Kalinka had returned home at around 5pm.
sentences.zh: 达妮埃尔说卡林卡在大约下午5点时回到了家。

sentences.en: She remarked that she was feeling tired and a little unwell, but other than that, she'd been her typical happy self.
sentences.zh: 她提到自己感觉有些疲倦和身体不适，但除此之外，她一直都是那个快乐的自己。

sentences.en: The family ate dinner together around 7.30pm, after which Dr. Kronbach's children went out and the others soon retired to bed for the night as normal.
sentences.zh: 一家人在晚上7点半左右一起吃了晚饭，之后克龙巴赫医生的孩子们出去了，其他人也像往常一样很快上床睡觉。

sentences.en: Danielle explained that the next morning,
sentences.zh: 达妮埃尔解释说，第二天早上，

sentences.en: Dr. Kronbach went to wake Kalinka up so they could go horseback riding together, only to find her lying in her bed, unconscious.
sentences.zh: 克龙巴赫医生去叫卡林卡起床，以便他们能一起去骑马，结果却发现她昏迷不醒地躺在床上。

sentences.en: He administered various injections in an attempt to revive her, but it was too late.
sentences.zh: 他进行了各种注射试图救醒她，但为时已晚。

sentences.en: She was already dead.
sentences.zh: 她已经死了。

sentences.en: With no physical explanation as to how Kalinka had died,
sentences.zh: 由于没有关于卡林卡如何死去的生理方面的解释，

sentences.en: Dr. Kronbach suspected that she'd most likely suffered from heat stroke after overexposure to the sun the previous day and had gone into shock as a result.
sentences.zh: 克龙巴赫医生怀疑她很可能是因为前一天过度暴露在阳光下而患上了中暑，并因此导致了休克。

sentences.en: Paramedics were called, but there was nothing they could do.
sentences.zh: 人们叫来了医护人员，但他们已无力回天。

sentences.en: Kalinka's body was taken straight to the funeral home.
sentences.zh: 卡林卡的遗体被直接送到了殡仪馆。

sentences.en: Andrei Bomberski couldn't believe what he was hearing.
sentences.zh: 安德烈·邦贝尔斯基简直不敢相信自己听到的一切。

sentences.en: Kalinka was a healthy, athletic teenager who lived an incredibly active lifestyle and had no underlying medical conditions.
sentences.zh: 卡林卡是一个健康、热爱运动的青少年，生活方式极其活跃，没有任何潜在的健康问题。

sentences.en: How could she have possibly died in her sleep, and from heat stroke no less?
sentences.zh: 她怎么可能在睡梦中死去，而且还是死于中暑？

sentences.en: Furthermore, it had only been around 29 degrees Celsius in Lindau, yet Kalinka was used to much hotter temperatures than that in France.
sentences.zh: 此外，林道当时的温度只有29摄氏度左右，而卡林卡在法国习惯了比这热得多的温度。

sentences.en: To Andrei, it simply didn't make sense.
sentences.zh: 对安德烈来说，这根本说不通。

sentences.en: His head still spinning, Andrei immediately travelled to Lindau.
sentences.zh: 脑子还在发懵的安德烈立刻动身前往林道。

sentences.en: He hoped that his son Nicholas could shed some further light on the situation, but the 11-year-old said there was nothing out of the ordinary
sentences.zh: 他希望他的儿子尼古拉斯能提供一些进一步的情况，但这个11岁的男孩说，在卡林卡去世的那天晚上，

sentences.en: about the way Kalinka had behaved on the night that she died.
sentences.zh: 她的行为没有任何异常之处。

sentences.en: She didn't exhibit any of the major signs of heat stroke, such as dizziness, confusion, slurred speech, or profuse sweating.
sentences.zh: 她没有表现出任何中暑的主要迹象，比如头晕、神志不清、言语不清或大量出汗。

sentences.en: Nicholas didn't even recall Kalinka mentioning she was tired.
sentences.zh: 尼古拉斯甚至不记得卡林卡提过她很累。

sentences.en: In Germany, it was protocol that police be notified and an autopsy be conducted for any death that wasn't directly attributed to natural causes.
sentences.zh: 在德国，如果死因不能直接归咎于自然原因，警方必须得到通报并进行尸检，这是常规程序。

sentences.en: Two days after Kalinka's death, two pathologists performed an autopsy on the teenager's body.
sentences.zh: 在卡林卡死后两天，两名病理学家对这名青少年的遗体进行了尸检。

sentences.en: Given the summer heat, her body was already in an advanced state of decomposition, yet they noted Kalinka's overall good health and hygiene.
sentences.zh: 鉴于夏天的炎热，她的遗体已经处于严重腐烂状态，但他们指出卡林卡总体健康状况和卫生情况良好。

sentences.en: An examination of Kalinka's airways and lungs revealed the presence of aspirated stomach contents,
sentences.zh: 对卡林卡气道和肺部的检查显示存在吸入性胃内容物，

sentences.en: which indicated that she'd likely vomited in her sleep and subsequently choked to death.
sentences.zh: 这表明她很可能在睡梦中呕吐并随后窒息身亡。

sentences.en: The pathologists estimated Kalinka had died around 7-8 hours after eating dinner, putting her time of death sometime between 3 and 4am on Saturday July 10, 1982.
sentences.zh: 病理学家估计卡林卡是在吃完晚饭后大约7到8小时死亡的，将其死亡时间定在1982年7月10日星期六凌晨3点到4点之间。

sentences.en: On the same day that the autopsy was conducted, a police officer questioned Dr Dieter Kronbach about the events leading up to Kalinka's death.
sentences.zh: 在进行尸检的同一天，一名警官就卡林卡死前的事件讯问了迪特尔·克龙巴赫医生。

sentences.en: Dr Dieter Kronbach explained that when Kalinka returned home from Lake Constance on Friday, she complained that she hadn't gotten much of a suntan.
sentences.zh: 迪特尔·克龙巴赫医生解释说，周五卡林卡从博登湖回家后，抱怨说自己没有晒黑多少。

sentences.en: Just before the family sat down for dinner at around 7.30,
sentences.zh: 就在一家人大约7点半坐下来吃晚饭之前，

sentences.en: Kronbach said he gave her an injection of cobalt falacet, an iron supplement that he claimed would help her tan more easily.
sentences.zh: 克龙巴赫说他给她注射了钴法拉西，这是一种铁剂补充剂，他声称这有助于她更容易晒黑。

sentences.en: Dr Kronbach recalled that Kalinka went to bed early, but then got up to get a glass of water at approximately 10.30pm.
sentences.zh: 克龙巴赫医生回忆说，卡林卡很早就上床睡觉了，但在大约晚上10点半又起床去喝了一杯水。

sentences.en: Around midnight, he noticed that Kalinka's bedroom light was still on.
sentences.zh: 午夜左右，他注意到卡林卡的卧室灯还亮着。

sentences.en: He peered in and saw that she was reading in bed.
sentences.zh: 他往里看了看，发现她在床上看书。

sentences.en: Kronbach asked her to turn the light off before going to bed himself.
sentences.zh: 克龙巴赫让她把灯关掉，然后自己也去睡觉了。

sentences.en: The next time he saw Kalinka was when he went into her room at around 9.30am, only to discover that she was unconscious in her bed.
sentences.zh: 他下一次见到卡林卡是在上午9点半左右进入她的房间时，却发现她昏迷在床上。

sentences.en: In a desperate attempt to revive her,
sentences.zh: 为了绝望地救醒她，

sentences.en: Dr Kronbach grabbed his doctor's kit and injected her with a narcotic as well as a neurotransmitter.
sentences.zh: 克龙巴赫医生拿了他的医疗箱，给她注射了一种麻醉剂以及一种神经递质。

sentences.en: Realising it was hopeless and that she was already dead, he phoned emergency services who came to the house and removed Kalinka's body.
sentences.zh: 意识到回天乏术且她已经死亡后，他打电话给紧急服务部门，他们来到家里将卡林卡的遗体运走了。

sentences.en: They noted no signs of violence apart from the injection marks on her thorax and right arm.
sentences.zh: 他们注意到除了胸部和右臂上的注射痕迹外，没有任何暴力迹象。

sentences.en: A local prosecutor reviewed the case and determined that no foul play had occurred.
sentences.zh: 当地检察官审查了此案，并确定没有发生谋杀犯罪。

sentences.en: They closed Kalinka Bomberski's file, leaving her family to grieve as they came to terms with this unforeseen tragedy.
sentences.zh: 他们结案了卡林卡·邦贝尔斯基的档案，留下她的家人在悲痛中接受这场意料之外的悲剧。

sentences.en: Back in France, André Bomberski tried to accept that his daughter was gone, but he couldn't shake the feeling that something wasn't right.
sentences.zh: 回到法国后，安德烈·邦贝尔斯基试图接受女儿已经离去的事实，但他无法摆脱那种感觉，觉得事情不对劲。

sentences.en: At Kalinka's funeral, he'd overheard whispers that she had died as a result of the iron injection that Dieter Kronbach had given to help her tan.
sentences.zh: 在卡林卡的葬礼上，他无意中听到私下议论说她是死于迪特尔·克龙巴赫为帮她晒黑而给她注射的铁剂。

sentences.en: This was the first André had heard about any such injection.
sentences.zh: 这是安德烈第一次听到有关这种注射的说法。

sentences.en: His ex-wife, Danielle, had made no mention of it.
sentences.zh: 他的前妻达妮埃尔对此字未提。

sentences.en: Danielle had also promised to send André a copy of the autopsy report, yet one week passed and then another, and still there was no sign of it.
sentences.zh: 达妮埃尔还答应给安德烈寄一份尸检报告的复印件，然而一个星期过去了，又一个星期过去了，依然不见踪影。

sentences.en: André called Danielle and demanded to know what was going on.
sentences.zh: 安德烈打电话给达妮埃尔，质问到底是怎么回事。

sentences.en: It was a difficult situation to navigate, given that the pair already had a complex history between them.
sentences.zh: 鉴于两人之间本就复杂的历史，这是一个很难处理的局面。

sentences.en: The two had met in the Moroccan city of Casablanca in the early 1960s, where André was overseeing a large accounting company that specialised in international taxation.
sentences.zh: 两人于20世纪60年代初在摩洛哥城市卡萨布兰卡相遇，当时安德烈在那里主管一家专门从事国际税收的大型会计公司。

sentences.en: They got married and had Kalinka shortly after, followed by Nicholas a few years after that.
sentences.zh: 他们结婚了，不久后有了卡林卡，几年后又有了尼古拉。

sentences.en: Life was good for the family of four.
sentences.zh: 这个四口之家曾经的生活很美好。

sentences.en: That was until Dieter Kronbach came along.
sentences.zh: 直到迪特尔·克龙巴赫出现。

sentences.en: At the time, Kronbach worked as a doctor for the German consulate in Casablanca and lived just a few doors down from the Bomberskys.
sentences.zh: 当时，克龙巴赫是德国驻卡萨布兰卡领事馆的医生，就住在邦贝尔斯基家几门之隔的地方。

sentences.en: Widowed with two young children who attended the same international school as Kalinka and Nicholas, the two families would occasionally cross paths.
sentences.zh: 作为丧偶且带着两个年幼孩子的单亲父亲，他的孩子和卡林卡、尼古拉就读同一所国际学校，两家偶尔会有所交集。

sentences.en: But over time, André noticed that Dr. Kronbach seemed to show up wherever they went.
sentences.zh: 但随着时间的推移，安德烈注意到克龙巴赫医生似乎无论他们去哪都会出现。

sentences.en: When the Bomberski family had a serious car accident in 1974, he was the first person to arrive on the scene.
sentences.zh: 1984年邦贝尔斯基一家发生严重车祸时，他是第一个赶到现场的人。

sentences.en: André started to suspect that something was going on between his wife and Dr. Kronbach.
sentences.zh: 安德烈开始怀疑他的妻子和克龙巴赫医生之间有什么不正当关系。

sentences.en: Eventually, Danielle admitted that the two were having an affair.
sentences.zh: 最终，达妮埃尔承认两人有染。

sentences.en: André confronted Dr. Kronbach, who refused to end the relationship with Danielle.
sentences.zh: 安德烈找克龙巴赫医生理论，但后者拒绝断绝与达妮埃尔的关系。

sentences.en: Desperate to save his marriage,
sentences.zh: 为了极力挽救他的婚姻，

sentences.en: André moved his family back to France.
sentences.zh: 安德烈把家人搬回了法国。

sentences.en: As he and Danielle worked to mend things between them,
sentences.zh: 正当他和达妮埃尔努力修补彼此的关系时，

sentences.en: Danielle got a job in real estate that required her to travel frequently to the city of Nice, which was on the other side of the country.
sentences.zh: 达妮埃尔在房地产行业找到了一份工作，需要经常去位于国家另一端的尼斯市出差。

sentences.en: She decided it was easiest if she rented an apartment there during the week and then returned home on the weekends.
sentences.zh: 她觉得在那里租一套公寓过周末再回家是最方便的。

sentences.en: André was a little suspicious of this.
sentences.zh: 安德烈对此有点怀疑。

sentences.en: One day, he followed Danielle as she left for work and found that she drove straight to a nearby apartment.
sentences.zh: 一天，他跟着出门上班的达妮埃尔，发现她直接开车去了一处附近的公寓。

sentences.en: It turned out that Dr. Dieter Kronbach had moved to France so he could continue his affair with Danielle.
sentences.zh: 原来迪特尔·克龙巴赫医生也搬到了法国，以便能继续他和达妮埃尔的婚外情。

sentences.en: André filed for divorce and Danielle married Kronbach shortly after.
sentences.zh: 安德烈提出离婚，不久后达妮埃尔便嫁给了克龙巴赫。

sentences.en: Things had been bitter between the exes ever since, with Kalinka's death marking yet another source of contention.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，这对前夫妻之间的关系一直很僵，而卡林卡的死则成了又一个争端来源。

sentences.en: When André called Danielle demanding to know what was going on with their daughter's autopsy,
sentences.zh: 当安德烈打电话给达妮埃尔质问女儿的尸检是怎么回事时，

sentences.en: Danielle thought he was overreacting.
sentences.zh: 达妮埃尔认为他反应过度了。

sentences.en: She encouraged André to make peace with the tragedy as best as he could by accepting that Kalinka's time had simply come.
sentences.zh: 她鼓励安德烈接受卡林卡的缘分已尽，以此来尽量平静地接受这场悲剧。

sentences.en: But André wasn't ready to let it go.
sentences.zh: 但安德烈并不打算就此罢休。

sentences.en: After numerous requests, three months after Kalinka's death, he finally got his hands on her autopsy findings.
sentences.zh: 在多次请求之后，在卡林卡去世三个月后，他终于拿到了她的尸检结果。

sentences.en: The 16-page report was written in German, so he immediately had it translated into French.
sentences.zh: 这份16页的报告是用德语写的，于是他立刻找人将其翻译成法语。

sentences.en: When André finally sat down to read the findings, he couldn't believe his eyes.
sentences.zh: 当安德烈终于坐下来阅读调查结果时，他简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。

sentences.en: The first thing André noticed was that the pathologists had concluded that the exact cause of Kalinka's death couldn't be determined.
sentences.zh: 安德烈注意到的第一件事是，病理学家得出结论，无法确定卡林卡的确切死因。

sentences.en: While she had choked on her own vomit, they didn't know what had caused her to throw up in the first place.

sentences.en: Knowing that he frequently travelled to Austria and Switzerland, Andrei visited police and custom posts throughout both countries,
sentences.zh: 深知他经常前往奥地利和瑞士，安德烈走访了两国各地的警察局和海关哨所，

sentences.en: handing out dossiers containing photos of Kronbach, newspaper articles detailing the allegations against him, and judicial warrants for his arreSt.
sentences.zh: 分发包含克龙巴赫照片、详细记载对他的指控的报纸文章以及逮捕令的档案。

sentences.en: The reactions were mixed.
sentences.zh: 反应褒贬不一。

sentences.en: Some treated Andrei as though he was crazy, while others were willing to listen to his story.
sentences.zh: 有些人把安德烈当成疯子看待，而另一些人则愿意听他讲述这段经历。

sentences.en: Either way, his efforts paid off in early January 2000, when a police officer in Western Austria recognised Dieter Kronbach from one of Andrei's photos and placed him under arreSt.
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，他的努力在2000年1月上旬得到了回报，当时奥地利西部的一名警察从安德烈的一张照片中认出了迪特尔·克龙巴赫，并将其逮捕。

sentences.en: He was detained as per the terms of the European Convention on Extradition that was in place at the time.
sentences.zh: 他根据当时生效的《欧洲引渡公约》的相关条款被拘留。

sentences.en: German officials called for his release, arguing that Kronbach had been cleared of any wrongdoing in his home country,
sentences.zh: 德国官员要求释放他，辩称克龙巴赫在其祖国已被洗脱任何不当行为的嫌疑，

sentences.en: and that the French arrest warrant was therefore a violation of his rights.
sentences.zh: 因此法国的逮捕令是对他权利的侵犯。

sentences.en: French officials didn't argue against this, and Kronbach was subsequently released and free to return to Germany.
sentences.zh: 法国官员对此并未反驳，随后克龙巴赫获释，并自由返回德国。

sentences.en: Kronbach and his legal team had been arguing against his manslaughter conviction in France ever since the sentence was handed down back in 1995.
sentences.zh: 自1995年宣判以来，克龙巴赫及其法律团队一直对他在法国被判过失杀人罪提出异议。

sentences.en: They petitioned to the European Court of Human Rights, asserting that France was wrong to conduct a trial without Kronbach or a legal representative there to defend him.
sentences.zh: 他们向欧洲人权法院提起申诉，坚称法国在没有克龙巴赫或为其辩护的法律代表出庭的情况下进行审判是错误的。

sentences.en: In 2001, the court concluded that by trying Kronbach in absenteeer,
sentences.zh: 2001年，法院裁定，通过缺席审判克龙巴赫，

sentences.en: France had violated several stipulations set out in the European Convention on Human Rights.
sentences.zh: 法国违反了《欧洲人权公约》中规定的几项条款。

sentences.en: They found that he'd been denied a fair hearing and his right to appeal, and that the sentence could therefore no longer be enforced.
sentences.zh: 他们认定克龙巴赫被剥夺了公正审判和上诉的权利，因此该判决不再具有强制执行力。

sentences.en: The court voided the conviction and ordered that the French government compensate Kronbach with 100,000 francs for costs incurred, which was around 15,000 euros at the time.
sentences.zh: 法院宣告该定罪无效，并下令法国政府向克龙巴赫赔偿10万法郎作为诉讼费用补偿，当时约合1.5万欧元。

sentences.en: This was a major blow for André Bombersky, whose allegations against Kronbach were finally being taken seriously after years of denial.
sentences.zh: 这对安德烈·邦贝尔斯基来说是一个沉重的打击，经过多年的矢口否认后，他对克龙巴赫的指控终于开始受到重视。

sentences.en: He implored French officials to appeal the decision to the Grand Chamber of the European Court of Human Rights, but his request was denied.
sentences.zh: 他恳求法国官员向欧洲人权法院大法庭对该裁决提起上诉，但他的请求被拒绝了。

sentences.en: They also refused his request to re-examine Kronbach's 1995 trial.
sentences.zh: 他们还拒绝了他重新审理克龙巴赫1995年审判的请求。

sentences.en: The entire legal process had been incredibly gruelling for André, both emotionally and financially, but still he refused to give up.
sentences.zh: 整个法律程序对安德烈来说无论在情感上还是经济上都极其折磨，但他仍然拒绝放弃。

sentences.en: André was convinced that the French authorities were prioritising their relationship with Germany over justice for Kalinka.
sentences.zh: 安德烈坚信，法国当局把他们与德国的关系置于为卡林卡伸张正义之上。

sentences.en: This suspicion only grew after he became aware of a report from Kronbach's legal team
sentences.zh: 在得知一份来自克龙巴赫法律团队的报告后，这种怀疑愈发强烈，

sentences.en: that claimed public prosecutors in Paris had assured them that Kronbach's sentence wouldn't be enforced.
sentences.zh: 该报告称巴黎的检察官曾向他们保证，克龙巴赫的刑罚不会被执行。

sentences.en: In André's view, the French had failed in their duty to catch Kronbach, who was now living freely as a convicted rapist in his home country.
sentences.zh: 在安德烈看来，法国人未能尽到抓捕克龙巴赫的职责，而如今这名被定罪的强奸犯正逍遥法外地生活在祖国。

sentences.en: In 2002, he filed a complaint against several French magistrates and prosecutors, alleging corruption and obstruction of justice.
sentences.zh: 2002年，他对几名法国法官和检察官提起诉讼，指控他们贪腐和妨碍司法公正。

sentences.en: As André's newly appointed lawyer explained to the French television show Bring in the Accused,
sentences.zh: 正如安德烈新委任的律师向法国电视节目《呼叫陪审团》所解释的那样，

sentences.en: It was an attempt to wake up a sleeping machine by the implementation of an explosion.
sentences.zh: 这就像是通过引爆一场爆炸来试图唤醒一台沉睡的机器。

sentences.en: A judge ruled there were no grounds for André's complaint and that the allegations wouldn't be investigated further.
sentences.zh: 一名法官裁定安德烈的起诉缺乏依据，相关指控将不再进一步调查。

sentences.en: The entire Kalinka-Bomberski case was transferred back to Germany, where a new prosecutor determined yet again
sentences.zh: 整个卡林卡·邦贝尔斯基案被移交回德国，一位新检察官再次判定

sentences.en: that no charges would be pressed against Dieter Kronbach in relation to the teenager's death.
sentences.zh: 不会就这名少年的死对迪特尔·克龙巴赫提起诉讼。

sentences.en: André was aware that he'd earned a particular reputation within the French legal circles as an annoyance.
sentences.zh: 安德烈深知自己在法国法律界落得了一个招人烦的特殊名声。

sentences.en: As much as this hurt him, it made him all the more determined to continue with the fight.
sentences.zh: 尽管这让他很受伤，但也让他更加坚定地将斗争进行到底。

sentences.en: In 2004, the European Union implemented a new system known as the European Arrest Warrant.
sentences.zh: 2004年，欧盟实施了一项被称为“欧洲逮捕令”的新制度。

sentences.en: This aimed to simplify and streamline the extradition process for suspects within the EU so that they could be transferred from one EU state to another
sentences.zh: 此举旨在简化和顺畅欧盟境内嫌疑人的引渡程序，以便他们能够从一个欧盟成员国移交给另一个成员国，

sentences.en: without the need for specific extradition treaties.
sentences.zh: 而无需特定的引渡条约。

sentences.en: As a result, French prosecutors issued a fresh European arrest warrant for Dieter Kronbach.
sentences.zh: 因此，法国检察官对迪特尔·克龙巴赫发出了崭新的欧洲逮捕令。

sentences.en: German officials denied it again, on the grounds that the case was closed.
sentences.zh: 德国官员再次予以拒绝，理由是该案已经结案。

sentences.en: Although André seemed to hit a dead end at every turn, he wasn't alone in his quest for justice.
sentences.zh: 尽管安德烈似乎处处碰壁，但在寻求正义的道路上他并不孤单。

sentences.en: By this point, a concerned citizen had created a group in support of André's cause titled
sentences.zh: 此时，一位热心市民发起了一个支持安德烈诉求的组织，名为

sentences.en: Justice for Kalinka, which soon amassed over 1,000 members from all walks of life.
sentences.zh: “为卡林卡伸张正义”，该组织很快聚集了来自各行各业的1,000多名成员。

sentences.en: Members held rallies, wrote letters to people in positions of power, and created a website detailing all the available information about André's legal struggles.
sentences.zh: 成员们举行集会，向当权者写信，并建立了一个网站，详细公布了关于安德烈法律斗争的所有可用信息。

sentences.en: German filmmaker Hilke Zinging was among those following Kalinka's case.
sentences.zh: 德国电影制作人希尔克·辛金就是关注卡林卡一案的人之一。

sentences.en: In 2006, she released a documentary dedicated to the allegations against Dieter Kronbach titled
sentences.zh: 2006年，她发布了一部专门针对迪特尔·克龙巴赫相关指控的纪录片，名为

sentences.en: Kalinka's Last Journey, which featured interviews with the Mauer sisters.
sentences.zh: 《卡林卡最后的旅程》，其中包含了对莫尔姐妹的采访。

sentences.en: After the documentary aired, Hilke received a letter from Kronbach in which he claimed that the
sentences.zh: 纪录片播出后，希尔克收到了克龙巴赫的一封信，他在信中声称，

sentences.en: sisters were lying about being drugged and sexually assaulted during their trip to the south of France.
sentences.zh: 姐妹俩关于在法国南部旅行期间被下药和性侵的说法是在撒谎。

sentences.en: Kronbach said he barely knew the girls and had never taken them on a holiday.
sentences.zh: 克龙巴赫称他根本不认识这些女孩，也从未带她们去度假过。

sentences.en: Yet, the Mauer sisters had provided Hilke with photographs that proved the trip had taken place, and these had been broadcast in the documentary.
sentences.zh: 然而，莫尔姐妹向希尔克提供了证明那次旅行确实发生过的照片，这些照片也在纪录片中播出了。

sentences.en: Speaking about Kronbach to the Guardian, Hilke later said,
sentences.zh: 希尔克后来在接受《卫报》采访谈到克龙巴赫时表示，

sentences.en: I have no idea if he has problems with reality.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他是不是对现实有什么认知障碍。

sentences.en: Around the same time that the documentary aired, a German librarian named Petra Steffen sat down at her computer.
sentences.zh: 大约在纪录片播出的同时，德国的一名图书管理员佩特拉·斯特芬坐在了电脑前。

sentences.en: Petra lived approximately 400 kilometres from Lindau in the German town of Rodenthal.
sentences.zh: 佩特拉住在距离林道大约400公里远的德国小镇罗登塔尔。

sentences.en: Her regular doctor had recently passed away, and she'd been given the name of his replacement.
sentences.zh: 她的常驻医生最近刚去世，而她拿到了他接替者的名字。

sentences.en: A curious person by nature, Petra typed the name of the new doctor into Google.
sentences.zh: 出于天生好奇，佩特拉在谷歌上输入了这位新医生的名字。

sentences.en: One of the first things that popped up was the Justice for Kalinka website, followed by Hilke Zinging's documentary.
sentences.zh: 弹出的第一批结果中就有“为卡林卡伸张正义”的网站，紧随其后的是希尔克·辛金的纪录片。

sentences.en: Petra was stunned as she learned about the crimes Dr Dieter Kronbach had been convicted of and discovered that he'd been banned from practising medicine entirely.
sentences.zh: 当佩特拉了解到迪特尔·克龙巴赫医生曾因何罪名被定罪，并发现他已被完全禁止行医时，她惊呆了。

sentences.en: She booked an appointment to see if the new doctor in town was indeed the same Dr Kronbach she was reading about.
sentences.zh: 她预约了一次面诊，想看看镇上的这位新医生是否真的是她所阅读的那位克龙巴赫医生。

sentences.en: After confirming that it was, Petra wasted no time in reporting him.
sentences.zh: 在确认确实是他之后，佩特拉毫不耽搁地举报了他。

sentences.en: Further investigation revealed that Dieter Kronbach had been working as a locum doctor all over Germany
sentences.zh: 进一步的调查显示，自从1997年因强奸罪被定罪并被吊销行医执照以来，

sentences.en: ever since his medical licence was revoked after his rape conviction back in 1997.
sentences.zh: 迪特尔·克龙巴赫一直在全德国各地担任临时替班医生。

sentences.en: He'd gotten away with it by producing a photocopy of his old medical licence, claiming that the original had been stolen.
sentences.zh: 他通过出示一张旧行医执照的复印件蒙混过关，谎称原件被偷了。

sentences.en: Crombach was charged with 28 cases of fraud and 19 cases of illegally practising medicine.
sentences.zh: 克龙巴赫被指控犯有28起欺诈罪和19起非法行医罪。

sentences.en: He was placed under arrest just as the authorities suspected he was about to flee overseas.
sentences.zh: 就在当局怀疑他准备逃往海外时，他被逮捕了。

sentences.en: According to the Netflix documentary My Daughter's Killer, police found him with a suitcase containing clothing, cash, and a penis pump used to treat erectile dysfunction.
sentences.zh: 根据Netflix纪录片《我女儿的凶手》记载，警察在他随身携带的一个手提箱里搜出了衣物、现金以及用于治疗勃起功能障碍的阴茎泵。

sentences.en: He was subject to a psychiatric assessment, with two psychiatrists concluding that he was a chronic liar, sexual predator, and a narcissist who believed he was outside the law.
sentences.zh: 他接受了精神评估，两名精神科医生得出结论，认为他是慢性说谎者、性掠夺者以及自恋狂，自认为凌驾于法律之上。

sentences.en: Kronbach was subsequently convicted and sentenced to two years and four months in a German prison.
sentences.zh: 随后克龙巴赫被定罪，并在德国监狱服刑两年四个月。

sentences.en: He served 18 months before being released early for good behaviour in June 2008.
sentences.zh: 他在服刑18个月后，于2008年6月因表现良好提前获释。

sentences.en: By this point, 26 years had passed since Kalinka Bomberski's death.
sentences.zh: 此时，距离卡林卡·邦贝尔斯基离世已经过去了26年。

sentences.en: Under French law, a 30-year statute of limitations meant there were only four years left
sentences.zh: 根据法国法律，30年的追诉时效意味着只剩下四年时间

sentences.en: in which legal action could be taken against Dieter Kronbach in relation to Kalinka's death.
sentences.zh: 可以就卡林卡之死对迪特尔·克龙巴赫采取法律行动。

sentences.en: After that, not only would he be free from facing any punishment, but he could also choose to sue André Bomberski for defamation.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，他不仅将免受任何惩罚，还可以选择起诉安德烈·邦贝尔斯基诽谤。

sentences.en: Following Kronbach's early release from prison, the Paris Court of Appeal admitted that his 1995 trial in absentia had been distorted under pressure from Germany.
sentences.zh: 在克龙巴赫提前出狱后，巴黎上诉法院承认，他在1995年的缺席审判受到了来自德国的压力而遭到扭曲。

sentences.en: The French warrant for his arrest was still in place, but other than that, in the eyes of the law,
sentences.zh: 法国对他的逮捕令依然有效，但除此之外，在法律层面上，

sentences.en: André Bomberski had exhausted all possible options when it came to getting justice for his daughter.
sentences.zh: 在为女儿寻求正义这件事上，安德烈·邦贝尔斯基已经用尽了所有可能的手段。

sentences.en: It was important to André that Kronbach knew he hadn't been forgotten.
sentences.zh: 对安德烈而言，重要的是让克龙巴赫知道他并没有被遗忘。

sentences.en: André travelled to Germany and tracked Kronbach down to Scheidegg, a small market town 20km inland from Lindau near the Austrian border.
sentences.zh: 安德烈前往德国，一路追踪克龙巴赫到了沙伊德格，这是一个位于林道内陆20公里、靠近奥地利边境的小集镇。

sentences.en: He visited every once in a while to keep an eye on Kronbach and to make his presence known.
sentences.zh: 他每隔一段时间就会去一次，以便盯着克龙巴赫并刷一下存在感。

sentences.en: Then in September 2009, André noticed a for-sale sign at the front of Kronbach's apartment.
sentences.zh: 接着在2009年9月，安德烈注意到克龙巴赫公寓门前挂出了一块出售标牌。

sentences.en: He spoke to some neighbours who told him that Kronbach had accepted a job in West Africa.
sentences.zh: 他与一些邻居交谈，得知克龙巴赫已经在西非接受了一份工作。

sentences.en: With the clock ticking and Kronbach on the move again, André knew it was now or never.
sentences.zh: 随着时间流逝，加之克龙巴赫又要动身，安德烈知道机不可失，失不再来。

sentences.en: I had enough in my head, he later told the Guardian.
sentences.zh: 我脑子里已经装得够多了，他后来对《卫报》说道。

sentences.en: I knew that the French government would do nothing.
sentences.zh: 我知道法国政府不会采取任何行动。

sentences.en: I knew that the German government would do nothing.
sentences.zh: 我知道德国政府也不会采取任何行动。

sentences.en: I decided that I had to do something.
sentences.zh: 我决定自己必须做点什么。

sentences.en: It was just after 3.15 on the morning of Sunday, October 18, 2009, when a call came through to police in the French city of Malouz.
sentences.zh: 2009年10月18日，星期天，凌晨3点15分刚过，法国城市马卢兹的警方接到了一通电话。

sentences.en: Go to the Rue de Thiel across from the customs office, an anonymous caller said.
sentences.zh: 去海关办公室对面的蒂尔街，一个匿名来电者说道。

sentences.en: You'll find a man tied up.
sentences.zh: 你们会发现一个被绑起来的男人。

sentences.en: The police station was only four blocks away.
sentences.zh: 警察局只有四个街区远。

sentences.en: Two squad cars raced to the narrow street near the centre of town.
sentences.zh: 两辆警车呼啸着冲向市中心附近这条狭窄的街道。

sentences.en: There, in a courtyard nestled between two buildings, they found an elderly man lying on the ground behind an iron gate.
sentences.zh: 在那里，在一处夹在两栋建筑之间的庭院里，他们在一扇铁门后面发现了一个躺在地上的老人。

sentences.en: It was Dieter Kronbach.
sentences.zh: 正是迪特尔·克龙巴赫。

sentences.en: He was curled on the pavement, his hands and feet bound together, and his mouth gagged with duct tape.
sentences.zh: 他蜷缩在人行道上，手脚被绑在一起，嘴巴被强力胶带封住。

sentences.en: His face was barely recognisable, battered, bruised and covered in blood.
sentences.zh: 他的脸血肉模糊、青一块紫一块，几乎认不出本来面目。

sentences.en: One of the police officers removed the tape from his mouth.
sentences.zh: 其中一名警察撕掉了他嘴上的胶带。

sentences.en: Bombersky is behind it, he said.
sentences.zh: 是邦贝尔斯基干的，他说道。

sentences.en: Kronbach was rushed to hospital, where he received treatment for a fractured skull.
sentences.zh: 克龙巴赫被紧急送往医院，并在那里接受了颅骨骨折的治疗。

sentences.en: He told the police that the previous evening he'd been at his home in Scheidegg when there was a knock on the door.
sentences.zh: 他告诉警察，前天傍晚他正待在沙伊德格的家中，突然有人敲门。

sentences.en: He answered it, only to find an unfamiliar man standing there.
sentences.zh: 他开门后，发现站着一个面生男子。

sentences.en: Are you, Kronbach?
sentences.zh: 你就是克龙巴赫吗？

sentences.en: The man asked with a thick Russian accent.
sentences.zh: 那名男子用浓重的俄语口音问道。

sentences.en: When Kronbach answered yes, the man punched him in the face.
sentences.zh: 当克龙巴赫回答“是”时，那人一拳打在他的脸上。

sentences.en: Two other men appeared and launched a violent attack.
sentences.zh: 另外两名男子出现并发动了暴力袭击。

sentences.en: They managed to bind and gag Kronbach before throwing him into the back seat of their car.
sentences.zh: 他们设法捆住并封住克龙巴赫的嘴，然后把他扔进汽车后座。

sentences.en: As the man drove along, Kronbach struggled and begged for his life.
sentences.zh: 车子行驶途中，克龙巴赫拼命挣扎并哀求饶命。

sentences.en: He offered to pay the trio 50,000 euros if they'd just let him go.
sentences.zh: 他提出只要他们放了他，就付给三人5万欧元。

sentences.en: Then, one of the men pulled out a knife and threatened to chop his penis off.
sentences.zh: 接着，其中一人掏出了一把刀，威胁要剁掉他的阴茎。

sentences.en: Suddenly, the driver pulled over and ordered the knife-wielding man out of the car.
sentences.zh: 突然，司机把车停下，命令持刀男子下车。

sentences.en: He said they had over 300 kilometres to go and couldn't risk doing the drive with a dangerous man with a weapon.
sentences.zh: 他说他们还有300多公里要走，冒不起风险载着一个带着武器的危险人物开车。

sentences.en: The car eventually crossed the border into France and stopped in Malouz, the first town they came upon that had its own police station and courthouse.
sentences.zh: 汽车最终穿过边境进入法国，并在马卢兹停了下来，这是他们遇到的第一个拥有警察局和法院的小镇。

sentences.en: The men dumped Kronbach, called the police, and fled.

sentences.en: André Bomberski wasn't with them, but Kronbach had no doubt that he'd orchestrated the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 安德烈·邦贝尔斯基并不和他们在一起，但克龙巴赫坚信整场行动都是他一手策划的。

sentences.en: The police looked into André's whereabouts the night before and confirmed he'd been in Toulouse the entire time.

sentences.en: However, they soon received word that André had booked a flight to Malouz that was scheduled to arrive that evening.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们很快接到消息称，安德烈已经预订了当晚飞往马卢兹的航班。

sentences.en: At 5pm, they drove to the hotel he'd booked in and placed him under arreSt.

sentences.en: André seemed genuinely shocked.

sentences.zh: 然而，对他的酒店房间进行搜查时，搜出了1.9万欧元现金，这让调查人员怀疑他曾花钱雇人替他实施袭击。

sentences.en: Investigators visited Kronbach's home in Scheidegg and found a utility bill near the scene.

sentences.en: On it was the address and phone number of an individual named Anton Krasnici, a Kosovan who lived in the Austrian town of Brigance.

sentences.en: André Bomberski had recently spent time in Brigance, which was right near the German border, just 20km from Dieter Kronbach's home.
